name: @edgegamers/s2s-maul
description: MAUL authentication for CS2 — an s2script port of edgegamers/maul-actain, speaking either the MAUL v1 or v2 API

maul_url.description: MAUL API root. Requests go to {root}/v1/... or {root}/v2/... per api_version; a trailing /v1 or /v2 is stripped, so https://maul3.edgegamers.com/api/v2 also works.

maul_key.description: MAUL API key, sent raw in the AUTHORIZATION header. Empty = authentication disabled.

api_version.description: Which MAUL API to speak: 'v1' (legacy base64-path) or 'v2' (maul3 JSON). Changing it needs a plugin reload.

server_ip.description: v1 only: override for the REQUEST_IP header. Empty = derive from the hostip/ip cvars. v2 identifies the server from its API key.

server_port.description: v1 only: override for the REQUEST_PORT header. 0 = derive from the hostport cvar.

ip_arg_encoding.description: v1 only: encoding of the client-IP arg on info: 'plain' (maul-legacy), 'base64' (maul3), or 'omit'.

user_agent.default: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/140.0 Safari/537.36
user_agent.description: User-Agent sent with API calls. Required for maul3 (Cloudflare 403s unrecognised agents). Empty = send none.

eventserver.description: Grant event-gated ranks (those marked "special" in the ranks table).

join_message.description: Broadcast a Dedicated Supporter's join message on their first join.

http_timeout_ms.description: Per-request timeout for MAUL API calls.

debug.description: Verbose logging, including request URLs and response bodies.

presence.description: v2 only: push this server's live roster to MAUL's presence dashboard over the v2 WebSocket. Off by default — an upgraded server should not start reporting its roster without being asked.

presence_interval_ms.description: How often to send a full roster snapshot, in ms. Reported to MAUL as cadenceMs — it derives its freshness window from this, so a value far below the default only makes the server look stale when one frame is missed. Floored at 5000.
